question: What scriptural citation introduces the requirement to worship the five gods?
premises: The five gods are to be worshipped.
This is stated in expectation of that worship.
The text cites 'Brahmā and so forth'.
inference: In expectation of worshipping the five gods, the text says 'Brahmā and so forth'.
plain_english: In expectation of worshipping the five gods, it is said: 'Brahmā and so forth.'
